items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Sally' in a list of projects ('Dalvatore' and 'k.y F'), but the interviewee does not respond to or acknowledge this specific name, nor does he mention Sally in his own turns.

ctx.x: I'm not a tough guy, in any sense. I'm tough on nobody. If people don't reproduce what I ask them to, and they're not capable of doing it, well I discover that and I make a decision; do I want them anyway, should I adjust to them or am I insistent on what I want? If I am insistent in having what I want, I would have to change the man. But otherwise--

When you were doing (Sally)" the thing for Boyd, "Dalvatore" and "k.y F" and all that material which was astonishing to those people I'm sure, and puzzling, were you satisfied with what they finally did in performance?
Yeah; right. You better switch that off for a moment.
